guide.intro: What Baradun Bada checks and shows, and what to know before you head to the sea.

check.title: What we check
check.warningBody: We check whether a KMA wind wave, strong wind, typhoon, storm surge or tsunami warning (advisory or warning) is in effect for each beach's warning zone.
check.nearby: Other warnings such as heavy rain, heatwave or cold wave don't change a beach's status; we show them only under Nearby warnings.
check.timeBody: We check when wave height was measured. If the wave height reading is more than 90 minutes late, we show 'Observation delayed'.
check.noStation: If there's no sensor within 20km in the same warning zone, we show only 'No nearby observation' in place of the value.

badges.title: What the badges mean
badges.clearBody: No sea-related warning was found. It doesn't mean it's safe.
badges.warningBody: We show the warning name as is. Avoid going into the sea and follow on-site guidance.
badges.unknownBody: We couldn't check warnings, so we can't tell right now. It doesn't mean there are no warnings.
badges.staleBody: Wave height measurements are late, so we can't tell right now. We'll check again when new values come in.

period.title: Reading wave period
period.body: Wave period is the time between one wave and the next. The longer the period, the more likely it's a big swell from far away, with more power.
period.note: We don't set number-based thresholds. Please judge for yourself whether the waves suit you.

safety.title: Safety rules by activity
safety.intro: Please follow these before going into the sea.

swimming.title: Swimming
swimming.rule1: Swim only while lifeguards are on duty, inside the marked swimming area.
swimming.rule2: Don't go in alone, and don't go in after drinking alcohol.
swimming.rule3: Warm up first and wear a life jacket.

surfing.title: Surfing
surfing.rule1: Wear a leash and surf where it matches your skill.
surfing.rule2: Don't surf alone, and keep your distance from others.
surfing.rule3: If a current pulls you out, move parallel to the shore to get out of it.

scuba.title: Scuba diving
scuba.rule1: Dive within your certification and experience, with a buddy.
scuba.rule2: Use a dive flag or buoy to show divers are below.
scuba.rule3: Check your gear before diving and keep to your planned depth and time.

safety.official: See official safety rules on the National Disaster Safety Portal

about.title: About the service
about.body1: Baradun Bada gathers KMA sea-related warnings and wave height measurement times for each beach.
about.body2: We show only facts that can be checked. We don't judge activity suitability or recommend beaches.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body1: Baradun Bada doesn't guarantee that using the sea is safe. 'No warnings' doesn't mean it's safe either.
disclaimer.body2: Information from official sources can be late or differ. We don't check access closures, so follow on-site guidance.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.locationBody: Used only to calculate distances on your device when finding nearby beaches. Never sent to a server or stored, and you can turn it off in Settings.
privacy.deviceBody: Favorites, recently viewed beaches (with when you viewed them and the activity you chose then), recent searches, default region, chosen activity, explore view, first-run records, unsent feedback (type and text, up to 7 days), display settings (theme, motion, language), the location setting and the last sea information received are saved only in this device's browser. There's no login and nothing is sent to a server. Everything except display settings, the location setting and the last sea information can be cleared in Settings › Reset device data.
privacy.inquiryBody: Feedback is kept for 90 days and photos for 30 days, then deleted automatically. Email is collected only if you leave it, and deleted as soon as handling is done (within 90 days at the latest). Photo location data is removed on your device before sending.
privacy.inquiryNoDeadline: We don't promise a reply deadline.

dataSources.intro: The information on screen is built from the public data and map data below.

principles.title: How we show data
principles.item1: Measured values come with the station name, distance and measurement time; warnings come with scope, KMA and check time.
principles.item2: Units are m, °C and m/s in every language.
principles.item3: We don't change official values or make new ones. If a value is missing or late, we say so.
principles.item4: When development sample data is shown, it's marked as a sample on screen.
principles.item5: Screens and guidance are available in Korean and English. Names without an official English name (for example, warning areas with no KMA English name) may stay in the original Korean on English screens.

kma.name: Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA)
kma.provides: Sea-related warnings (wind wave, strong wind, typhoon, storm surge), tsunami warnings, ocean buoy and wave buoy observations (wave height, water temperature, wind, wave period, wave direction)
kma.terms: Under the Weather Act (in force from 2026-09-18), every screen that shows KMA data or information made from it (beach status badges, measured values, charts) shows “Source: KMA”. Public Data Portal license: Weather Warning Service is KOGL Type 1 (attribution); Earthquake Information Service has no restrictions. Buoy observations come from the KMA API Hub.

khoa.name: Korea Hydrographic and Oceanographic Agency (KHOA)
khoa.provides: Surfing point list (names and coordinates only; index values aren't used), rip current index (only for beaches where provided)
khoa.terms: Public Data Portal license: Surfing Index and Rip Current Index are both KOGL Type 1 (attribution). Surfing is shown based only on point names and coordinates from KHOA “Surfing Index” (KOGL Type 1).

tour.name: Korea Tourism Organization
tour.provides: Reference beach photos (TourAPI). Not the current sea.
tour.terms: We use only KOGL Type 1 (attribution) photos and show the source next to each photo. Beaches without a Type 1 photo show an illustration.

mof.name: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries
mof.provides: Designated beach list and operating periods (Beach Opening and Closing Schedule), beach names and locations (Beach Information Service)
mof.terms: Public Data Portal license: Beach Opening and Closing Schedule and Beach Information Service both have no restrictions.

boundary.name: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT)
boundary.provides: Legal eup/myeon/dong boundaries (Legal District Information). Used only to find which eup/myeon/dong a beach's coordinates fall in and link the beach to KMA land warning areas. The boundaries themselves aren't shown or redistributed.
boundary.terms: Legal District Information (법정구역정보) by MOLIT (국가공간정보센터), used under the Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 Korea license (CC BY 2.0 KR). We didn't modify the boundaries; each beach's eup/myeon/dong and land warning area link are results we derived from them.

map.name: Map
map.provides: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, vector tiles © OpenMapTiles, tiles served by OpenFreeMap, map style Positron (modified from the OpenFreeMap version)
map.terms: OpenStreetMap data is under the ODbL, and attribution is shown on the map. The Positron map style is Copyright (c) 2024, MapTiler.com & OpenMapTiles contributors · Copyright (c) 2015, CartoDB Inc.; its code is under the BSD 3-Clause License and its design under CC-BY 4.0. Positron is derived from CartoDB Basemaps, designed by Stamen and Paul Norman for CartoDB Inc. (CC-BY 3.0).
